content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I've encountered persistent challenges trying to get [product_name] running. I purchased a license CD from my local dealer. When I install the 64-bit version, it freezes as soon as I start a new project. The 32-bit version launches, but fails to establish any connections and shows a Java-related error regarding the 64-bit version. I tried installing 32-bit Java, but had little success. I initially suspected that my VLAN setup, used to connect to another PC for CD access (since I don't have a CD drive), might be the issue, but I get the same problems even with the demo version downloaded online. Is there a solution to this ongoing problem? Attached is an image of the error from the licensed 32-bit install.
It's not possible to run a 32-bit software version on a 64-bit computer.

The 32-bit version is somewhat functional—I can start new projects and add features, but connecting to [product_name] doesn't work. The 64-bit version locks up when creating new projects and can only be closed using Task Manager.

Which [product_name] version did you install—[version_no] or an earlier one? Check the program info, and please let us know the controller you're using, along with the [article_no]. For the 32-bit version, you don't need external Java. There are two installer options for [product_name] 32-bit, one with included Java and one without.
The CD I received is [version_no]. I believe the demo on the [company_name] website is also the latest version, [version_no]. My controller has [article_no].

I didn't experience any issues installing the 64-bit version—it works correctly for me. If you can carry out all tasks except transferring your program to the controller, verify that your network uses the same subnet. New controllers typically have IP 192.168.0.3 and subnet 255.255.255.0. Also, try using the blue icon in the transfer menu to locate your controller. If nothing works, please provide more details about the error messages you receive. If you must use the 32-bit version, check if there are two different versions on your CD.
The installation is halted by this error message.

It appears that the application is trying to access a 64-bit DLL using a 32-bit program. The installation order may be affecting things. Consider fully uninstalling [product_name] and reinstalling it. Make sure you have admin rights during the process.
I did install the 32-bit version with administrator privileges. Unfortunately, the 64-bit version does not work at all.

It seems you installed the 64-bit version either before or after the 32-bit version. Without further details, it's hard to assist—just an error message doesn't give enough information to diagnose the problem. Wishing you success.
If needed, I can help remotely using TeamViewer. Let me know when you're ready if you'd like to try this.

analysis.insight_summary: Forum participants report major difficulties installing and running both 32-bit and 64-bit versions of [product_name] ([version_no]) on 64-bit Windows. Users found the 64-bit version freezes when opening a new project, while the 32-bit version partly runs but won't connect to controllers, with Java compatibility and DLL errors also contributing. The repeated troubleshooting over several days reveals notable issues with onboarding and compatibility.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a dependable installation process, straightforward project setup, and smooth connectivity between [product_name] and the controller on their Windows systems, irrespective of the software's bit version.
